To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the SPC/E, SPC, and TIP4P intermolecular potential functions predict similar structures, while those of MSPC/E and TIP5P are quite dissimilar.
the structure of liquid water as described by the SPC and SPC/E models is the least similar and most dissimilar to the structures predicted by the other models, respectively.
the SPC/E, SPC, and PPC interaction models generate the most disordered structures, while the TIP4 and TIP5P interaction models produce the most similar structures.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microscopic structure of water as predicted by classical intermolecular models.
the microscopic structure of water at the level of three-particle correlation function, which has not been studied before.
the microscopic structure of water at ambient conditions, and the comparison of six classical intermuclear potential models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SPC/E and TIP4P are the most realistic models for the microscopic structure of water.
the TIP4 water model is the most similar in structure to liquid water.
the SPC model is the most simple, but also the least accurate model among the studied ones.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TIP4 and TIP5 models are the best choices among the studied models, while the TIP5 model is the most realistic one.
the structure of liquid water predicted by the classical intermolecular models is not universal.
the SPC/E and TIP4P models are the most similar, while the SPP and MSPC/E models are the least similar.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the SPC/E and TIP4P models generate similar structures, and they can be used to predict properties of liquid water with comparable quality.
the structure of liquid water predicted by the TIP4 and the SPC/E intermolecular models is the most similar, and the structure of the SPC/E model is closer to the PPC model than to the TIP4 model.
the structure of water at ambient conditions is not sensitive to the choice of intermolecular potential model.
